layout: A full-width strip on the top edge, 26px tall, filled edge to edge with the theme bar background (opaque by default). It has no border, separators, rounding or shadow. Five sections, configured in config/omarchy/shell.json: left=[omarchy.menu, omarchy.workspaces]; centerBegin=[omarchy.indicators]; center=[omarchy.clock]; centerEnd=[omarchy.elsewhen, omarchy.weather, omarchy.system-update]; right=[omarchy.tray, omarchy.keyboard-layout, omarchy.agents, omarchy.bluetooth, omarchy.network, omarchy.audio, omarchy.monitor, omarchy.power]. Each section is a GridLayout with columnSpacing 0 and rowSpacing 0, so the gap between widgets is always 0px. All visual spacing comes from each widget's own slot width: 27px for panel icons, 21px for status icons, 20px for workspace buttons, and text width + 17.5px for the clock. LEFT is anchored at x = 8 (Style.space(8)) and vertically centred. RIGHT is anchored with its right edge at barWidth - 8. CENTER: the centre box holds only the clock. Its x = round((barWidth - boxWidth) / 2), computed over the full bar width and ignoring the left and right sections; nothing prevents overlap. centerBegin hangs off the box's left edge (x = box.x - width) and grows leftward. centerEnd starts at box.x + box.width and grows rightward, so the clock stays exactly centred whatever the side lists hold. All widgets are 26px tall and top-aligned in their slot (Qt.AlignLeft|Qt.AlignTop), which fills the bar's height. Widgets that are hidden take 0px: their slot width is 0 when the item is not visible. Visibility by default: menu always; workspaces always; indicators 0px wide unless an indicator is active (hovering the bar left of the centre box reveals the inactive ones at 0.45 opacity); clock always; elsewhen always; weather once its first fetch returns an icon; system-update only when an update is available; tray only when at least one non-passive StatusNotifier item exists (by default every item sits in the collapsed drawer, so only a 27px chevron U+F053 shows); keyboard-layout only with more than one layout or input method; agents always; bluetooth only when a BlueZ adapter exists; network always; audio always; monitor always; power only when UPower reports a battery. At 1440px wide on a laptop (battery and BT adapter, no tray apps, one keyboard layout, no pending update, weather loaded), with workspaces 1 and 2 occupied and 1 active: menu 8..35; workspaces 35..140.5 (buttons at 35, 56, 77, 98 and 119, each 20 wide with 1px gaps, then a 1.5px trailing gap); clock 'Monday 14:05' in a box about 103.9px wide (12 glyphs x 7.2px JetBrains Mono advance + 17.5; the advance is runtime-dependent), x = round((1440-103.9)/2) = 668, so about 668..771.9; elsewhen 771.9..792.9; weather 792.9..813.9; right group 1270..1432: agents, bluetooth, network, audio, monitor and power, each 27px.

Button opacity changes animate

While a widget's panel is open, a pill sits under it on a top bar: accent colour, 0.9 opacity, 2px tall, fully rounded, inset 2px from the bottom (y = 26-2-2 = 22). Width = max(10, round(slotWidth*0.55)), which is 15px for a 27px slot. The clock uses its text width.
items.expr: color: Commons.Color.accent; opacity: 0.9; height: Style.space(2); y: parent.height - height - inset; inset: Style.space(2); x: Math.floor(center - width/2)

items.what: Bubble placed 6px below the hovered widget and centred on it. Padding is 20px total horizontal and 14px total vertical. Text is 12px. Corners use cornerRadius (0 by default). The first tooltip waits 400ms; later ones show at once.
items.expr: localY = target.height + 6; implicitWidth: tooltipLabel.implicitWidth + 20; implicitHeight: tooltipLabel.implicitHeight + 14; font.pixelSize: Style.font.body; tooltipTimer.interval: 400

items.what: Shell corner radius mirrors Hyprland decoration:rounding, which defaults to 0. Only the tooltip and drag outlines use it; the bar itself has no radius.

workspaces.visibleSlots: Always buttons 1-5 of the monitor's block. Workspaces 6-10 appear only while they exist in Hyprland. Visiting workspaces from another monitor's block follow after a 6px gap. Sorted ascending. With workspaces 1 and 2 occupied there are 5 buttons: 1 2 3 4 5.

label.align: centred in the 20x26 button, plus the digit-centring offset (items text.verticalOffset)

empty.note: A workspace counts as empty when it does not exist in Hyprland or has no toplevels. The 0.5 applies to the whole button.

active.text: layout glyph replaces the number: dwindle U+F14FB (square: tiles), scrolling U+F0765 (circle), floating U+F0536 (triangle)
active.note: The active workspace is marked only by the glyph swap. It gets no colour, pill, underline or background. Default Hyprland layout is dwindle, so U+F14FB.

clock.locale: Day names follow the Omarchy language (I18n.formatLocale), not the system locale

Color.bar.text = pick("bar.text", foreground); template text = {{ foreground }}. All labels and glyphs use it via bar.barForeground.
Color.bar.active = pick("bar.active", urgent); template active = {{ red }}. Bound to bar.urgent and used for the attention state.
Color.accent, used only for the open-panel mark under the bar

Used only if no theme colors.toml loads

notes: Gaps between widgets are 0px everywhere (GridLayout columnSpacing 0). A replica must reproduce slot widths exactly, not add CSS gap.

Icon sizing is optical: each glyph is shaped at 13px (12px for WidgetButton glyphs such as the workspace layout icon). Its tight ink bounds are then measured, and the glyph is scaled so the larger ink dimension is exactly 12px and the ink centre sits at the 16px canvas centre, which is centred in the slot. A web replica should measure each glyph's bounding box (canvas measureText or SVG getBBox) and scale and translate it. Rendering at font-size 12 and centring the advance box will not match. Source: shell/Ui/OpticalGlyph.qml:20-60, shell/Ui/BarIconButton.qml:13,36-82.

Runtime-dependent: clock text width. JetBrains Mono's advance is 600/1000 em, 7.2px at 12px, but Qt NativeRendering with hinting may round advances, so the clock slot is 101.5-103.9px for 'Monday 14:05'. The day name also changes the width ('Wednesday' is 3 glyphs wider), and the centre box re-centres around it.

Runtime-dependent: the digit-centring vertical offset for text labels comes from font metrics (descent - ascent + height of '0') / 2. For JetBrains Mono at 12px it is about 0 to +0.5px, so labels sit at or a hair below geometric centre.

Fractional geometry: the workspaces widget is 105.5px wide (1.5px trailing gap, Style.spaceReal(1.5)), and the clock slot (text + 17.5) is fractional. Everything after them in the same section lands on half-pixel or fractional x. Whether QtQuick.Layouts snaps these to whole pixels was not verified.

Runtime-dependent visibility: weather (after its fetch), system-update (pending update), tray (StatusNotifier items present), keyboard-layout (multiple layouts), bluetooth (adapter present) and power (battery present) all collapse to 0px when hidden. A desktop without battery or BT shows only agents, network, audio and monitor on the right (108px).

Background modes: 'opaque' (default) fills the strip with bar.background. 'glassy' keeps its RGB at alpha <= 0.35 and relies on Hyprland blur. 'none' is transparent, and the text colour is then chosen at runtime by the omarchy-bar-text-color script from the wallpaper under the bar (Bar.qml:1484-1550). Double-clicking empty centre space cycles clear, glassy, opaque.
There is no hover affordance on any bar widget: no fill, no colour shift, no underline. The only feedback is cursor, tooltip (400ms first delay), press scale 0.9, and the accent open-panel pill.
The active workspace is shown only by swapping its number for the layout glyph (U+F14FB under default dwindle). Its colour, weight and opacity match an occupied workspace.
The centre box is centred on the full bar width with no collision handling against the left or right sections.

The indicator peek: hovering the bar anywhere left of the centre box's start (BarModel.peeksAt) reveals the inactive indicators. The centerBegin area jumps from 0 to 126px, growing leftward from the clock with no width animation, and each icon fades to 0.45 over 140ms. It closes 120ms after the pointer leaves.
Bar fades out under a real fullscreen window (Bar.qml:1796-1811). Not relevant to the stock view.

Glyph meanings marked MDI or Font Awesome are inferred from Nerd Fonts codepoint ranges, not stated in the Omarchy source. The codepoints themselves are read verbatim from source. The workspace layout meanings (square tiles, circle scrolls, triangle floats) are stated in a source comment, Workspaces.qml:132-133.
Unresolved: the exact glyph shape of the agents icon U+F16A3 and the Omarchy-font logo U+E900; their outlines live in font files that were not inspected.
